purpose: Teach: デリー/サウジアラビア/ユナイテッド/ダライ/家康/ジュネーブ/トロイ/台北

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがデリーの絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to read you a picture book about Delhi.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried. Sharing a small joy meant for him. Gentle rising at the end, inviting his delight. Soft-spoken, like passing along a secret.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとサウジアラビアの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I looked at a picture book about Saudi Arabia with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, quick-paced excitement. The proud rush of sharing something he did. Small laugh underneath. No hesitation—he wants her to know immediately.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがユナイテッドのジャージを下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad gave you a United jersey.
lines.style: Thoughtful, noticing pause. Slight warmth on the observation, like she's seeing something dear in the small gift. Steady tempo, genuine.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ダライ・ラマって誰?お父さんに聞くね
lines.en: Mei-sis, who's the Dalai Lama? I'm going to ask Dad about it.
lines.style: Curious but unbothered by his own not-knowing. Quick question, no self-consciousness. Natural impulse—he figures Dad will know, Dad will tell him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが徳川家康の絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to read you a picture book about Tokugawa Ieyasu.
lines.style: Same gentle rhythm as before. A slight smile in the voice—she knows this matters to him. Unhurried, sharing something quietly special.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとジュネーブの地図見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I looked at a map of Geneva with Dad!
lines.style: Same brightness as his earlier lines, maybe slightly more assured. Quick tempo, earnest. The joy of having done this, having it be real.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがトロイの絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to read you a picture book about Troy.
lines.style: Same gentle register, but with a thread of quiet knowing—she's noticed a pattern. Warm throughout. Inviting him into this moment with her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと台北のお話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I heard a story about Taipei with Dad!
lines.style: Warmest yet. Genuine happiness, no performance. Settled and complete. The contentment of having shared something real with someone he trusts.
